h1: Do I need a permit to replace siding in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Siding Replacement Permits: Repairs and Historic Review
description: Learn how ordinary siding repairs differ from larger exterior renovation work and when Newton historic review applies.
short_answer: The state building code exempts ordinary repairs, but the exact permit requirement for full siding replacement depends on the work being performed. Newton has a roofing and siding permit application category. Properties in a Local Historic District must obtain historic review for exterior changes, including siding replacement.

facts.text: The state building code exempts ordinary repairs from its permit application requirement. It does not define every possible siding replacement project as an ordinary repair.
Newton's historic preservation guidance says even small repairs and replacements such as siding may require review by preservation staff or the district commission.

qa.q: Can I replace siding without historic review if I use the same material?
qa.a: Do not assume so. Newton says small siding repairs and replacements in Local Historic Districts require preservation review; staff can determine whether the work qualifies for an administrative approval.
